I re-checked `dev` at `5aa8a3f88f87` after the compact-figure change, and it still meets the venue requirements. I made no changes and left no comment this turn.

- **Pages:** the build is 24 pages. The main text ends on page 9 and page 10 starts in the references, so the 9-page limit holds.
- **Figures:** every figure PDF has text of 7 pt or larger. Figs. 1, 2, 3 and 5 are now exactly 396 pt wide, the text width.
- **Template:** `paper/template/` is unchanged since `3daa538`.
- **Outline:** the Outline revision this activation flags only continues the earlier revisions. Nothing in it concerns the venue.

My approval on `paper-repo`#5 was given on the earlier head `eabd347e5737`. I didn't re-check whether the PR head has moved to include the compact figures.
